info.title: Assessment & Exam Platform API Documentation
info.description: Complete API definitions for the online assessment platform, supporting role-based user authentication, bulk question uploads, auto-generated exams, student evaluation violations tracking, and analytics dashboards.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: User registration, login, and profile lookup APIs

tags.name: Questions
tags.description: CRUD operations, spreadsheet bulk uploads, and document parsing templates

tags.name: Exams
tags.description: Create exams, query publish structures, auto-generation, and blueprints scheduling

tags.name: Submissions
tags.description: Start exams, record questions, update security violations, and auto/manual evaluations

tags.name: Results
tags.description: Query grade cards, percentages, rankings, and exam feedback reviews

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Platform activity metrics, topic strengths, and scoring breakdowns

post.description: Registers a new Admin, Teacher, or Student. User email must be unique, and passwords must be at least 6 characters.

400.description: Validation failed or duplicate email address

post.description: Verifies login credentials and returns a Bearer JWT access token.

get.description: Fetches current authenticated user data using Bearer token authorization.

post.description: Allows Admins and Teachers to create questions. MCQ questions require non-empty `options` lists and matching `correctAnswer` values.

get.description: Retrieves questions with pagination support, fuzzy keyword search, and exact matching filters.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Fuzzy text search query matching questionText

put.description: Updates an existing question record. Enforces role security checking on modifications.

post.description: Enables bulk importing of multiple questions in Excel or CSV format.

file.description: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file containing question sheets

400.description: File parser error or headers parsing mismatch

get.description: Downloads the pre-formatted `.xlsx` bulk upload template containing correct column headers and sample data rows.
Downloads the pre-formatted `.csv` bulk upload template.

post.description: Creates a new exam in draft status. EndTime must fall chronologically after StartTime.

get.description: Retrieves Exams list. Admins see all exams; Teachers see exams they created; Students see only published exams.

post.description: Automatically selects a specified amount of easy, medium, and hard questions matching the subject parameter and generates a draft Exam structure.

400.description: Insufficient questions inside the selected category or bad body inputs

post.description: Generates a draft exam automatically using specific percentage weights mapping distributions across chapters and difficulties.

chapterWeights.description: Object mapping chapter names to weight percentages (must sum to 100)

difficultyWeights.description: Object mapping difficulty ratings to weight percentages (must sum to 100)

201.description: Exam successfully generated via blueprint distribution logic

400.description: Incorrect weight sums, missing questions in target chapter buckets, or validation failures

get.description: Retrieves the core properties and question bindings for a single exam.

put.description: Updates details for an existing exam structure.

patch.description: Transitions an Exam from status `'draft'` to `'published'`. The exam must have at least 1 question bound to it to allow publishing.

400.description: Attempting to publish an empty exam or an exam already published/closed

post.description: Starts or resumes an exam attempt for the authenticated Student. Rejects started submissions if the current time falls outside the Exam's scheduled duration window.

400.description: Target exam is not published or the scheduled timeframe has passed

get.description: Retrieves submissions containing Short Answer responses awaiting teacher evaluations. Teachers see only submissions relating to exams they created; Admins query globally.

post.description: Saves or updates a student's answer text for a specific question. Allowed only for the student owner while the attempt state is `'started'`.

400.description: Target question does not exist in exam, submission is finalized, or scheduled window is closed

post.description: Finalizes the exam submission and scores MCQ questions immediately. Short Answers are left in `'pending'` evaluation status. Recalculates total score and spawns Result record if no short answers are present.

put.description: Enables Teachers and Admins to award marks and write feedback notes for Short Answer questions. Once all answers are graded, submission transitions to `'graded'` status and compiles the student's Result record.

feedback.example: Well reasoned and detailed answer structure.

overallFeedback.example: Great overall performance on the coding questions.

400.description: Marks exceed the maximum threshold for the question, or invalid submission status

patch.description: Updates browser focus tracking metrics (tab switches, copy-paste block limits, fullscreen exit actions) during an active assessment attempt.

400.description: Attempting to update violations on a finalized/graded exam attempt

get.description: Retrieves attempt details and security metrics. Checked via RBAC (Students can only fetch their own; Teachers can query submissions to their created exams; Admins can fetch any).

403.description: Attempting to query details for an exam attempt belonging to another student

get.description: Allows a student to retrieve their own final graded exams, containing percentages, grades, rank positions, and feedbacks.
Allows a Teacher to retrieve grading lists and candidate score details for exams they published.
Allows Admins to retrieve all final student graded results across the platform.
Returns strong/weak subjects categorization and progress metrics lists sorted chronologically for the logged-in student.
Compiles analytics insights for questions accuracy lists, difficulty category averages, and exam highest/lowest/average scores.
Calculates volume summaries of users (students/teachers), exams status distributions, and questions configurations globally.

options.description: Required only for MCQ. Must contain at least 2 distinct values.

correctAnswer.description: Required only for MCQ. Must exist in the options list.

expectedAnswer.description: Required only for Short Answer questions.
